items.title: Jackie Cain and Roy Kral interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York City, New York, March 22, 1998
items.q: And we were working in a place called John Walsh’s 88 Club?

ctx.x: And after that we just — everywhere, Detroit, and up to St. Paul, Minneapolis, out to California, we were there for a long time. And out in California we were doing once again just piano and the two voices. And we were working in a place called John Walsh’s 88 Club?
